cues.en: From this distant vantage point, the earth might not seem of any particular interest. But for us, it's different. Consider again that dot. That's here. That's home. That's us. On it, everyone you love, everyone you know, everyone you ever heard of, every human being, whoever was, lived out their lives. The aggregate of our joy and suffering,
cues.zh: 从这遥远的视角望去，地球似乎并没有什么特别之处。但对我们而言，意义却截然不同。再看看那个光点。那就是这里。那就是家。那就是我们。每一个你爱的人、每一个你认识的人、每一个你听说过的人，以及曾经存在过的每一个人，都在这上面度过了他们的一生。我们所有的欢笑与苦难，

cues.en: thousands of confident religions, ideologies, and economic doctrines. Every hunter and forager, every hero and coward, every creator and destroyer of civilization, every king and peasant, every young couple in love, every mother and father, hopeful child, inventor and explorer, every teacher of morals, every corrupt politician, every superstar, every supreme leader,
cues.zh: 成千上万笃信的宗教、意识形态和经济学说。每一个猎人与采集者，每一个英雄与懦夫，每一个文明的创造者与毁灭者，每一个国王与农夫，每一对热恋中的年轻情侣，每一个母亲与父亲，满怀希望的孩子、发明家与探险家，每一个道德导师，每一个腐败的政客，每一个超级巨星，每一个最高领袖，

cues.en: Every saint and sinner in the history of our species live there on the mode of dust suspended in a sunbeam. The earth is a very small stage in a vast cosmic arena. Think of the rivers of blood spilled by all those generals and emperors so that in glory and triumph they could become the momentary masters.
cues.zh: 我们人类历史上的每一个圣人与罪人，都生活在这里——悬浮在阳光中的一粒尘埃之上。在浩瀚的宇宙竞技场中，地球不过是一个极小的舞台。想想那些将领和帝王所洒下的血泊，只为了在荣耀与胜利中，成为转瞬即逝的主宰者。

cues.en: of a fraction of a dot. Think of the endless cruelties visited by the inhabitants of one corner of this pixel on the scarcely distinguishable inhabitants of some other corner. How frequent their misunderstandings. How eager they are to kill one another. How fervent their hatreds. Our posturings. Our imagined self-importance.
cues.zh: 而主宰的，不过是这光点上的一小部分。想想这颗像素点某个角落的居民，施加给另一角落几乎无法区分的同胞们的无尽残忍。他们之间的误解是多么频繁。他们渴望杀戮彼此的心情是多么迫切。他们的仇恨是多么狂热。我们的装腔作势。我们妄自尊大的优越感。

cues.en: The delusion that we have some privilege to position in the universe are challenged by this point. It's a lonely speck in the great enveloping cosmic dark. In our obscurity, in all this vastness, there is no hint that help will come from elsewhere to save us from ourselves. The Earth is the only world known so far to harbor life. There is nowhere else
cues.zh: 我们以为自己在宇宙中享有特权地位的幻觉，都在这个光点面前土崩瓦解。它只是笼罩一切的无垠宇宙黑暗中，一粒孤独的微尘。在我们的渺小与这片无垠之中，没有任何迹象表明，会有来自外界的援手拯救我们于自身的迷途。地球是迄今为止唯一已知孕育生命的世界。别无他处，

cues.en: at least in the near future, to which our species could migrate. Visit? Yes. Settle. Not yet. Like it or not, for the moment, the Earth is where we make our stand. It has been said that astronomy is a humbling and character-building experience. There is perhaps no better demonstration that the folly of the Union conceits than this distant image of our tiny world. To me,
cues.zh: 至少在不久的将来，人类还无法移居到别处。去造访？可以。去定居？还不行。无论喜欢与否，此时此刻，地球是我们唯一的立足之地。有人说，天文学是一段让人学会谦逊、塑造品格的经历。或许没有什么能比这张从远方回望我们微小世界的照片，更能揭示人类盲目自大的愚蠢。对我而言，

cues.en: It underscores our responsibility to deal more kindly with one another and to preserve and cherish the pale blue dot we've ever known.
cues.zh: 它更凸显了我们的责任：要更友善地对待彼此，并悉心守护与珍惜这颗我们所知唯一的淡蓝色暗点。
